zakat.claim_evidence: The search results for the US-based Al Jazari Institute (located in Minneapolis, Minnesota) do not explicitly mention that the organization accepts zakat donations on its website or donation pages. While some results mention 'zakat' and 'Jazari', these are explicitly linked to a UK-based entity (e.g., 'Ibn Al Jazari Institute® Birmingham UK' and 'zakat@jazari.co.uk' with a London phone number), which is a different organization. The US organization's mission focuses on Islamic educational services and civic engagement, but there is no clear evidence of dedicated zakat funds or campaigns for the US entity. (Source: https://ibnaljazariinstitute.com/donations/)

rich_narrative.summary: Al Jazari Institute offers Islamic education and civic engagement programs to individuals and families in the USA [1]. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $2,330,141</cite> [2]. Its core curriculum encompasses <cite id="1">Qur'anic Sciences, Islamic Sciences, Arabic Programs, and Islamic Studies</cite> [1]. Financial filings from FY2023 reflect program service revenue of <cite id="2">$1,389,723</cite> alongside contributions of <cite id="2">$1,586,418</cite> [2]. Overall, the institute balances traditional religious instruction with community programs, though it faces recent revenue contractions and gaps in public outcome measurement.
